about: Every input the BBC Micro's two models are measured from: where it came from, who made it, its licence as stated where it was found (null when none is stated), when it was fetched, and its size and SHA-256. The tools never fetch: each input is fetched by hand into the folder BBC_MODEL_INPUTS names, under `file`, and the tools refuse a file whose SHA-256 is not the one here. `width` and `height` are the pixels as stored (null for a file that is not an image). `committed` names the resized copy in site/src/assets/photos/ when there is one; a scan, or an input with no stated licence, is never committed. The ids are those of docs/bbc-micro/facts/models.md.
